hints: Start inside the brackets. The power comes next, before the ×.
Work out 7 − 4 first, then square the result.
Multiply your squared number by 3, then subtract 5.

solution.methodName: PEMDAS: brackets, powers, × ÷ left to right, + − left to right

steps.why: The small ² means multiply the number by itself. It does not mean × 2.

trapNotes.13: This reads ² as × 2: 3 × 3 × 2 = 18, then 18 − 5 = 13. 3² means 3 × 3 = 9.
trapNotes.76: This multiplies before squaring: 3 × 3 = 9, then 9² = 81, and 81 − 5 = 76. The power belongs only to the bracket, so square first, then multiply.
trapNotes.94: This squares each number in the bracket: 7² − 4² = 49 − 16 = 33, then 3 × 33 − 5 = 94. Work out the bracket first: 7 − 4 = 3, then square it.
